name: Milena of Meliode
source:
The middle child of the Meliode princesses, Milena (aka Millie) is [url=/c166919]Ravena[/url]'s childhood best friend. Unlike Ravena, however, she has a very mild temperament and would much rather spend her time studying than going on little adventures with her best friend. Due to her high intelligence, she has mastered all four of the basic elements, making her a formidable opponent. It is said that to this day, she is the only person to beat Ravena in a private duel the two held.

[In game description]
